label: preparing
what: The innkeeper, builder and freight operator are jointly preparing an eighteen-hundred town-hall gathering with bread refreshments, deliveries and lighting. The baker supplies the bread, including an original 120-loaf order and eighty additional loaves paid for by builder; secretary arranges the appointment and escort. I have been told of the gathering but not its full purpose or arrangements. Reports of bridge or port changes are unconfirmed; there is insufficient evidence to specify a more secret purpose.
